events.name: Florida Gators v Baylor Bears Men's Basketball
events.info: The Florida Gators take on the Baylor Bears on Sunday, October 18. The matchup, part of the Jacksonville Hoops Showdown series, will bring two prominent college basketball programs to Vystar Veterans Memorial Arena for a preseason showcase ahead of the 2026-27 season. Widely regarded as the preseason No. 1 team in the country, the Gators will enter the season with championship expectations. Tickets will be available through a one-day presale beginning Tuesday, September 15, at 11:00 a.m. ET. The public on-sale begins Wednesday, September 16, at 11:00 a.m. ET. Fans can register for presale access at the link below.

events.name: The 16th Annual TOFA Awards
events.info: 16th Annual TOFA (The Outstanding Filipino Awards) Saturday, October 24, 2026 | Doors 7:00 PM | Show 8:00 PM Terry Theatre at Jacksonville Center for the Performing Arts | Jacksonville, Florida Tickets from $150 on Ticketmaster. Celebrate the brilliance of the global Filipino community at the 16th Annual TOFA (The Outstanding Filipino Awards) ? a night of inspiration honoring Filipino excellence, leadership, and artistry across the world. Hosted by the ?King of Talk? Boy Abunda, this year?s celebration will feature live performances, celebrity appearances, and the recognition of this year?s outstanding honorees from various fields. Founded in New York and previously staged in Los Angeles, Honolulu, and Las Vegas, TOFA returns to the East Coast after three remarkable years on the West Coast.
